surfaces.part: thatched/wood roof over the shrine row

answer.evidence: Rows 0-9 form a roof or canopy plane about 10 rows tall. Its brown plank/thatch texture, moss patches and a bright row 0 darken steadily toward the bottom. Column scans show L=144 at row 0 falling to 51 at row 9, which reads as a sloped surface ending in dark eave shadow at rows 8-9. Below it, rows 10-31 show the front (south) face: three seated jizo statues with red bibs on a stone base, 22 rows tall. No receding side face is drawn. The roof reading is somewhat uncertain because the vertical streak texture could also be a front-facing fascia, but the graded shading and the dark shadow band favour a roof.
